Six retained reports use a2ea3e85 and Details uses b80da474; individual report provenance is explicit. No run/experiment mutations submitted. Scores do not establish WCAG conformance, performance, real AT or device usability. Readiness checked with actual accessibility snapshots.

reviewedWarnings.disposition: Retained for transparent review. The primary Search/node action name matches its visible primary label. Supplementary shortcut/type/status text is intentionally separate and exposed through aria-keyshortcuts/title or aria-describedby; final browser snapshots and unit tests confirm these descriptions remain available. No action names changed to satisfy the heuristic. This semantic review does not substitute for actual speech-control or screen-reader testing.

layoutChecks.scope: Readiness snapshots, not held-response transition measurements; production harness covers pending-to-ready geometry separately.
